audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings claim Pantheon's passive blocks Mel's autos: spikes[1].text 'his passive blocks your early autos', the early text 'his passive blocks my opening autos', whys[0] 'his passive blocks your autos', and wants.foe[0] 'Block your early autos with his passive'.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' It does not block basic attacks. The block-basic-attacks passive was Aegis Protection on the pre-rework Pantheon and no longer exists. This matters practically: the advice built on it tells a ranged mage her level-1 autos are wasted, when in fact auto-attack harassment is one of her few free actions at level 1 — and it hides the real level-1 threat, which is the empowered spear.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts; the threat is a point-click Shield Vault stun into that empowered Comet Spear, not an auto-attack block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings give Shield Vault's range as 575: spikes[0].text 'his W stun has to close 575 range' and the early text 'because his W has to close 575 range I'm already poking through'.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 600 range. 575 is Comet Spear's listed range, so the two have been swapped. The argument the sentence is making — that Mel pokes from outside his gap-close — is still correct, but the number a player memorises for their spacing should be the right one.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault appears nowhere in either layer.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.' Against a poke mage whose entire pattern is fanning Radiant Volley into him, a directional damage immunity on a 22/21/20/19/18 cooldown is the one button that turns her rotation into nothing. It is also the longest cooldown in his laning kit, so poking it out is a real win condition.
audit.corrected: Added to phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns and whys[2] — never volley into the brace; it is 22s at rank 1.
sources: champ-data/_kits/pantheon.json E Aegis Assault description and cooldown

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls this HARD, difficulty 8/10, carry threat 8.5/10, with all seven phases marked 'Pantheon'. The content layer's chart gives Mel five of seven phases and the matchup wins at 54.55%.
audit.why: This is a straight inversion, not a disagreement of degree — the full layer says Pantheon owns every stage of a lane the content layer and the win rate both say Mel wins. Whichever one the site renders, one of them is telling the player the opposite of the truth.
audit.corrected: EVEN, 5/10, carry threat 6.5/10; phases Skill / Mel / Mel / Mel / Skill / Mel / Mel.
sources: scratchpad packet mel.json entry pantheon (winRate 54.55, games 11, levelChart)

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's level-1 phase said 'Q volleys win every level-1 range war', the same template used in every other Mel matchup.
audit.why: Level 1 is the one phase in this matchup that Pantheon genuinely owns — the content layer says so explicitly and lists it as his threat window. The templated line contradicts the site's own level chart two fields away.
audit.corrected: Level 1 rewritten around Mortal Will's empowered spear and conceding the wave.

notes: UNVERIFIED CLAIM I DID NOT WRITE: champ-data/_kits/_missing-interactions.json asserts "Pantheon's Aegis Assault (E) is a channel — your Solar Snare (E) cancels it outright." I left this out. The claim is generated from the kit's derived 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it' flag, and roots are not generally channel-interrupting crowd control in League. Whether a root specifically cancels Aegis Assault is exactly the sort of thing the kit file is documented as not knowing, and it needs a League Wiki check before it goes anywhere near the site — if it is wrong, a player throws their only CC at a braced Pantheon and dies. The same file's 'untargetable-dodges-burst' headline for Aegis Assault is also shaky: Riot's text says invulnerable to damage from the front, which is directional damage immunity, not untargetability. I wrote only the directional wording. OUT-OF-BAND EDITS: all seven full:phases[N].side flips ('Pantheon' -> 'Mel'/'Skill'). full:diff ('HARD' -> 'EVEN') is the same length and should apply. SAMPLE SIZE: 11 games.
